meta.name: alfworld-object-cooler
meta.description: Cools a held object using an appropriate cooling appliance such as a fridge or freezer. Use when the task requires reducing the temperature of an object (e.g., "cool some pot", "chill the mug") and the agent is already holding the object. Performs the ALFWorld `cool` action and outputs the cooled object ready for subsequent placement or serving steps.

copy.tagline: 用冰箱或冰柜冷却手中物品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在ALFWorld环境中需要冷却物品
copy.tagline_en: Cool a held object using a fridge or freezer
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to cool objects in ALFWorld

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以在 ALFWorld 环境中冷却手中物体。当它拿着物体并位于冰箱或冰柜旁时，执行冷却动作，将物体变凉。
howto.when: 当 Claude 手中持有需要冷却的物体，且所在位置有制冷设备（如冰箱）时触发。

say.note: Claude 会将锅放入冰箱冷却。
Claude 会执行冷却杯子的动作。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to cool a held object in ALFWorld. When holding an object and near a cooling appliance like a fridge or freezer, it performs the cool action to chill the object.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is holding an object that needs to be cooled and is located at a cooling receptacle, e.g., fridge or freezer.

say_en.note: Claude will cool the pot using a fridge.

say_en.text: Chill the mug in the freezer.
say_en.note: Claude will cool the mug using a freezer.
